# Review: address book UI fixes (`1103786b9...59a0ede5b`)

**Verdict: OK to open the PR, but settle the "Requested by" cell first.** Score about 82/100, adjudicated 2 of 8.

The main problem is that approvers of pending contact requests lose the requester's name and may see a clipped address. Nothing I found is a security issue or a crash. The rest are small layout and test gaps.

Mode: range review of `1103786b9...HEAD`, committed work only, 7 commits. Read-only, so I didn't run tests or render the app.

7 files, +183 −25, base `1103786b9` → HEAD `59a0ede5b` · web app, TypeScript/React, jest · stated rules from `AGENTS.md` and `apps/web/AGENTS.md`.

| Area | Score | Note |
|---|---|---|
| Regression | 80 | F1 |
| Bugs | 82 | F2, F3, F5, F8 |
| Testing | 88 | F7 |
| Conventions / KISS | 92 | F4 |
| DRY | 94 | covered in F1 (reuse `AddedBy`) |
| Accessibility (in KISS) | 95 | F6 |
| Security, performance, architecture | 100 | checked; nothing found |

## Fix or confirm before opening

**F1 · P2 · Regression: the requester's name no longer shows (CONFIRMED, weakened on appeal)**
`apps/web/src/features/spaces/components/SpaceAddressBook/PendingRequestsTable.tsx:174-185`
- **What:** Before, the cell used `<EthHashInfo onlyName …/>` with `showName` left at its default of true. A requester whose wallet is in the local or space address book appeared by name. Now the address branch passes `showName={false}`, so admins always see the raw hex address (`EthHashInfo/index.tsx:20`).
- **Why it matters:** Admins deciding whether to approve lose the easiest cue for who asked.
- **Appeal:** The refuter pointed out the change looks deliberate. The new test at `__tests__/PendingRequestsTable.test.tsx:60-67` locks in the raw-address output. So this is a product call, not an accident.
- **Suggested fix:** Either keep the name lookup, or reuse `AddedBy` from `SpaceAddressBookTable.tsx:25`. `AddedBy` resolves member name → address → email and is fed by `useMemberNameResolver` with `req.requestedByUserId`, which the DTO already provides. Reusing it also fixes the email branch rendering an identicon of an email string, which `AddedBy` handles with `EmailInfo`.

**F2 · P2 · Bugs: the full "Requested by" address gets clipped and hides the highlighted last 4 bytes (CONFIRMED by CSS reasoning, weakened on appeal)**
`PendingRequestsTable.tsx:110`, `:175-184`
- **What:** The cell now shows the full 42-character mono address with `highlight4bytes`. Its column stayed at `w-[20%]`, which is about 144px at the table's `min-w-[720px]` and about 200px on a typical desktop. The address needs roughly 300px.
- **Why the tail disappears:** `.addressContainer { white-space: nowrap }` together with `overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis` (`SrcEthHashInfo/index.tsx:151`, `styles.module.css:19-23`) cuts from the right. The right end is exactly where the bold last-4-bytes highlight sits.
- **Appeal:** The full value is still in the tooltip at `:196`. Below MUI's `sm` breakpoint, `EthHashInfo` shortens the address on its own.
- **Not verified:** No browser render.
- **Suggested fix:** Widen the column when the address is shown, or use `shortAddress`. The tooltip already carries the full value.

## Worth a ticket or your call (P3)

| # | Where | What |
|---|---|---|
| F3 | `PendingRequestsTable.tsx:107-111` | On small screens the column widths add up to 15+40+15+20+15 = **105%**. With `table-fixed` the browser rescales them, so the intended proportions never apply. |
| F4 | `PendingRequestsTable.tsx:2-3, 40-41, 107-109` | Widths switch in JavaScript using MUI `useMediaQuery(down('lg'))`, which is 1200px. That returns false on the server render, so widths jump after hydration. The sibling table, `PaginatedDataTable/index.tsx:169`, uses Tailwind `md:` classes, and `SpaceAddressBookTable` uses `useIsMobile`. Responsive Tailwind classes such as `w-[15%] xl:w-[20%]` would avoid the hook and the jump. |
| F5 | `PendingRequestsTable.tsx:120` | This PR adds a long-name tooltip to the address book Name column, but the Pending tab's Name cell is still a bare `truncate` span. That column also shrinks to 15% on small screens, so long names are cut off with no way to read them. |
| F6 | `SpaceAddressBookTable.tsx:101` | `TooltipTrigger` renders a `<button>` by default. Every row now has a focusable "button" that does nothing, and the tooltip shows even for names that aren't truncated. Other places use `render={<span …/>}`, for example `SpaceSelectorDropdown.tsx:181`. |
| F7 | `AccountItemChainBadge.test.tsx:42`; `SpaceAddressBookTable.test.tsx:169-174`; `PendingRequestsTable.test.tsx` | The single-chain test asserts that the heading is absent, but it never rendered in single-chain mode, so the assertion can't fail. The name-tooltip test only checks that a button exists, not the tooltip content. The pending-requests tests don't cover `showName`, the "Requested by" tooltip, or the non-address strings from the API ("Unknown user", "Deleted user"). |
| F8 | `PendingRequestsTable.tsx:173-175` | The tooltip trigger renders a `<span>` that wraps a `<div>`, which is invalid HTML nesting. Using a `<span>` wrapper, or `render={<div …/>}`, fixes it. |

## Worth tidying (no score impact)

- `PendingRequestsTable.tsx:1, 23`: `react` is imported twice (`useState`, then `useMemo`). Merge into one import.
- `PendingRequestsTable.tsx:57, 86`: `spaceId ?? ''` is redundant after the `if (!spaceId) return` guard.

## Not covered

- I didn't run tests, type-check, or render the app, as asked. F2's clipping comes from reading the CSS, not from a screenshot.
- Only F1 and F2 were tested by paired agents (one confirming, one trying to disprove). F3 is simple arithmetic. F4–F8 were checked by me alone and keep full weight.
- The Cypress selector `multichain-tooltip` (`cypress/e2e/pages/sidebar.pages.js:45`) still exists. No test uses the removed "Multichain account on:" text, so dropping it breaks nothing.

Separately, some claude.ai connectors (Slack, Gmail, Google Drive and others) need authorising in your claude.ai connector settings before they work. None of them were needed for this review.
